doc.title: ZID–ZDC LOA
doc.summary: Interfacility coordination between Indianapolis ARTCC (ZID) and Washington ARTCC (ZDC): general handoff/turn rules, CRW and Rainelle shelf items, airport group definitions, and the route/altitude restriction tables in both directions.

items.title: Purpose and disclaimer
items.text: Establishes coordination procedures and airspace delegation between VATUSA Indianapolis ARTCC (ZID) and Washington ARTCC (ZDC), supplemental to FAA Order 7110.65. For virtual ATC use only; not for live NAS operations.

items.title: Assign Attachment A/B routes and altitudes
items.text: Specific routes and altitudes must be assigned for arrivals and departures as depicted in Attachment A (ZDC to ZID) and Attachment B (ZID to ZDC) unless otherwise coordinated.

items.title: Vector up to 15° within 15 miles of boundary
items.text: Either Center may vector aircraft up to 15 degrees without prior coordination provided the aircraft is within 15 miles of the boundary. Heading information forwarded via fourth line supersedes control for turns authorized in the agreement.

items.title: J149/Q72: ZID right turns; establish by GEFFS/HACKS
items.text: ZID has control for right turns for aircraft on J149/Q72 west of Q103. ZDC must establish aircraft on J149/Q72 no later than GEFFS/HACKS.

items.title: ZDC departures within 50nm of boundary: FL230
items.text: Departures from ZDC airports within 50 nm of the boundary shall be handed to ZID climbing to FL230 or lower requested altitude. The LOA does not list these airports.

items.title: Between J8 and Q176: direct HVQ OK
items.text: ZDC may clear aircraft between J8 and Q176 direct HVQ without coordination.

items.title: Q176 direct HNN if north of J6
items.text: ZDC may clear aircraft via Q176 direct HNN without coordination provided they remain north of J6.
items.restr: Direct HNN if north of J6

items.title: CRW+ arrivals: direct handoff to CRW ATCT AOB 10000
items.text: ZDC may hand CRW+ arrivals directly to CRW ATCT provided they are at or below 10000 (and correct for direction of flight) and will not touch ZID airspace. CRW+ is not expanded in the LOA (ABC+ means the airport and satellites within that ATCT).
items.restr: Direct to CRW ATCT if AOB 10000, no ZID airspace

items.title: ZID departures via PKB/AZQ (incl. PKB, CRW+): FL230
items.text: ZID will hand departures via PKB and AZQ sectors (including PKB and CRW+ departures) to ZDC climbing to FL230 or lower requested altitude.

items.title: CRW ATCT: descent and turns up to 30°
items.text: CRW ATCT has control for descent and turns of up to 30 degrees.

items.title: Rainelle Shelf 7000-10000 on request
items.text: ZDC may request control of the Rainelle Shelf from 7000 to 10000 from CRW ATCT.

items.title: Definitions: boundary, ABC+, airport groups
items.text: Boundary = ZDC/ZID common boundary. ABC+ = ABC airport and other satellites within ABC ATCT; ABCz = unspecified sector of ABC ATCT. CMH+ = CMH, LUK, OSU, TZR, LCK, FFO, ILN. CVG+ = CVG, LUK, HAO, I69, K62. DCA+ = DCA, DAA, ADW. ORF+ = ORF, FAF, PHF, LFI, NGU, NTU, CPK, PVG, SFQ. RIC+ = RIC, FCI, PTB, OFP.
